delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.intro: We deliver orders to all of Indonesia. This page tells you how the delivery works.

sections.heading: Where we deliver
sections.body: We deliver to addresses in all of Indonesia. Type your full address at checkout, so that the courier can find you.

sections.heading: Delivery price
sections.body: The delivery price depends on your address and on the weight of your order. Checkout shows the price before you pay.

sections.heading: Tracking
sections.body: After we send the parcel, the order page shows the tracking link.

returns.title: Returns and exchanges
returns.intro: If a piece does not fit or does not suit you, you can return it or exchange it.

sections.heading: How to return
sections.body: Contact us with your order number and the items that you want to return. We tell you how to send the items back.

sections.heading: Exchanges
sections.body: To get a different size or colour, contact us. We send the new piece when it is in stock.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: We check the items when we receive them. Then we send the refund and tell you by email.

about.title: Our story
about.intro: We make clothes for ordinary days: easy shapes, calm colours, fair prices.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: We are a small clothing label in Indonesia. We design pieces that you can wear on most days, for a long time.

sections.heading: How we make our clothes
sections.body: We choose comfortable fabrics and simple shapes. We make small quantities, so that we do not make more than people need.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page tells you which data we keep about you and why we keep it.

sections.heading: The data we keep
sections.body: We keep your name, your email address, your mobile number, your addresses and your orders.

sections.heading: Why we keep it
sections.body: We use the data to deliver your orders, to send the order emails and to answer your questions. We do not sell your data.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can change your profile and your addresses in your account. To delete your account, contact us.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: These terms apply when you buy from this store.

sections.heading: Orders
sections.body: When you place an order, we send a confirmation by email. We prepare the order after we receive the payment.

sections.heading: Prices and payment
sections.body: All prices are in rupiah. Checkout shows the full price, with the delivery price, before you pay.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body: We deliver to addresses in Indonesia. The delivery page gives more information.

sections.heading: Returns
sections.body: You can return or exchange a piece. The returns page tells you how.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Send us a message. We reply within one working day.
